purpose: Provenance/applicability inventory, not runtime configuration or approved property set
primary_scope: Silva2018 section3.2 pp69-81 and specified fit tables; Silva2020 section2.4

entries.temperature_or_domain: Temperature, moisture, batch and uncertainty not established
entries.adoption_decision: Do not call same-batch calorimetry; obtain original measurement basis/applicability before using in U(T,w).

entries.temperature_or_domain: Volume basis and batch equivalence unresolved
entries.adoption_decision: Confirm matrix/net-brick/envelope/bed basis and whether density changes with shrinkage; not independently measured for70C here.

entries.temperature_or_domain: T printed; nomenclature T is drying-air degC. Real fractional-power branch requires T<=374.14; this is not a validated domain.
entries.adoption_decision: Need upstream temperature/pressure validity and phase/interface temperature definition. Not bound-water sorption heat or a clay-specific closure.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Ta printed; nomenclature drying-air degC; upstream domain not read
entries.adoption_decision: Preserve Ta versus Tabs distinction; convert kJ to J before use with solid Cp/h. Fluid correlation from a grain-drying paper is not itself a grain material property.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Tabs in K; pressure/range not established
entries.adoption_decision: Pure-fluid candidate only, not wet clay heat capacity; upstream coefficients and applicability await verification.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Tabs in K; pressure/range not established
entries.adoption_decision: Use same energy reference and units only after verification; not a bound-water or phase-equilibrium model. Source subscript v means vapor (nomenclaturePDF23), not by itself constant-volume Cv; heat-capacity constraint must be identified before energy use.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Described as local atmospheric pressure; no same-run pressure log here
entries.adoption_decision: This equals standard atmosphere, not evidence of a measured chamber pressure history.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Eq3.43 contains molar mass Ma and absolute temperature
entries.adoption_decision: Printed unit does not match universal molar R; matching kmol basis is a dimensional interpretation only. Preserve source value, no runtime substitution.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Ta numerical Celsius temperature
entries.adoption_decision: Conversion identity can be used with explicit variable basis; does not qualify fluid/material property correlations.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Absolute temperature; air composition/molar-mass basis must match R
entries.adoption_decision: Need consistent mol/kmol units and dry/moist-air composition; not a measured density.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Tabs in K; phase and validity range unresolved
entries.adoption_decision: Not a sorption law for clay. Upstream equation/validity and liquid versus ice boundary not established; not adopted.

entries.printed_unit: No unit in Eq3.45; nomenclature percent
entries.temperature_or_domain: x_a water-vapor/dry-air mass ratio
entries.adoption_decision: Result is a fraction; distinguish percent presentation. Requires known pressure and vapor partial-pressure basis, not a measured RH record.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Flow/geometry/Re/Pr validity not specified here
entries.adoption_decision: Not solid conductivity. Need original correlation regime, external-versus-channel flow, development length and actual fluid properties; no h value generated.

entries.printed_unit: No unit beside equation; nomenclature Dh mm
entries.temperature_or_domain: Circular full cross section
entries.adoption_decision: Useful geometric identity; use metres with SI k,mu,rho; does not establish channel flow or heat-transfer validity.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Rectangular full cross section of sides a,b
entries.adoption_decision: From4*cross-section-area/wetted-perimeter; variable a here is a length, distinct from earlier a as area. No velocity or convection coefficient implied.

entries.temperature_or_domain: rho kg/m^3, w m/s, D m, mu Pa s
entries.adoption_decision: Actual flow and viscosity still required; source Dh in mm needs conversion before SI evaluation.

entries.temperature_or_domain: cp J/(kg K), mu Pa s, k W/(m K)
entries.adoption_decision: Use cp in J, not unconverted kJ; air transport coefficients not numerically established in reviewed subsection.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Fixed-geometry model statement
entries.adoption_decision: Do not splice into a shrinking-domain problem without a consistent volume/density update. This is not an observed constant-volume fact.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Fixed-geometry model statement
entries.adoption_decision: Exposed/channel/contact/radiation areas still require geometry and placement; not a uniquely established specimen boundary area.

entries.quantity: Specific interfacial area per bed volume
entries.temperature_or_domain: Industrial bed geometry; nomenclaturePDF21 instead lists m^2
entries.adoption_decision: New definition clarifies length^-1 meaning; does not supply absolute single-brick area or a measured surface-transfer coefficient.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Bed/brick-count/cart-volume basis; nomenclaturePDF23 says product porosity
entries.adoption_decision: Use explicit equation to distinguish bed loading from matrix porosity and23channel fraction; do not silently erase inconsistent nomenclature.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Moving cart in industrial tunnel
entries.adoption_decision: Not oven air velocity, shrinkage speed or measured boundary for the70C batch specimen.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Cross-flow industrial bed domain
entries.adoption_decision: L here is tunnel length, not brick width L in C.4; cannot replace experimental oven dimensions.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Seven spatial zones in tunnel dryer
entries.adoption_decision: Symbolic inlet settings for industrial simulation; not same-run oven T/RH/velocity/removal logs. Printed diagram rounded position labels kept separate in report.

entries.source_value_or_expression: Eq3.9/3.36 with six fitted coefficients per condition
entries.printed_unit: Ai dimensionless; Ki min^-1 inferred from t basis
entries.upstream_reference: Source fitted experiments; model form cites Lima1995, Lima&Mata1996, Nascimento2002, Silva2009
entries.temperature_or_domain: Six nominal50-100C conditions; exact fitted rows and weights not reproduced
entries.adoption_decision: Source coefficients archived in drying_fit.csv; cannot substitute for independently measured diffusivity/sorption/permeability.

entries.printed_unit: Dimensionless fit, source numerical time convention
entries.upstream_reference: Source fitted experiments; form cites Azzouz1996, Perez1998, Farias2011
entries.temperature_or_domain: Six nominal50-100C conditions; normalization issue retained
entries.adoption_decision: Coefficients archived in temperature_fit.csv; not heat capacity/conductivity and not proof of internal isothermality.

entries.upstream_reference: Source fitted dimensions and mass; form cites Silva2009
entries.temperature_or_domain: Same specimens; V computed from dimensions
entries.adoption_decision: Coefficients archived in shrinkage_fit.csv; not independent mechanics/shrinkage validation and not a deformation map.

entries.temperature_or_domain: Source regression procedure
entries.adoption_decision: Not measurement uncertainty, material accuracy or a physical-law tolerance.

entries.source_value_or_expression: Qs=ms*cp*deltaT; QL=mwev*hfg; ET=Qs+QL; QT=ET/delta_t; SMR=mwev/ET; MR=mwev/delta_t; SEC=ET/mwev
entries.upstream_reference: No cp/hfg numerical value, validity range or property-specific citation supplied in section2.4
entries.temperature_or_domain: Time intervals between mass/temperature observations
entries.adoption_decision: Not independent calorimetry or measured total oven energy. Section does not close wet storage/binding energy; conversions must be explicit.
